Built in ca-tools 2026-11-11 from the quadratic character of GF(73) alone. The 73 x 73 array has entry 1 at row x and column y when x + y is a nonzero square modulo 73 and 0 when it is a non-square. The 73 cells with x + y = 0, where the character is not defined, are left free. With those cells unknown, 4380 patterns on sets of four columns are not covered by the other rows, and every one of them can be covered by 2 or 3 choices of free cells (programs/need.c lists them). A simulated annealing search over the 73 free cells and 5 added rows, one cell changed per move, cost the number of listed patterns still uncovered (programs/ls.c, command ls 73 5 need73.txt 0.35 4000000000 3), reached 0 after 1,487,564 moves. Its output is programs/patch_m5_seed3.txt and programs/build.py writes the array from it. Two of the five added rows are constant. Exact check with ca_verify, all 4-sets

Built in ca-tools 2026-11-12 by an exact SAT model of an array invariant under a column group. Columns 0 to 16 are the residues modulo 17; the group generated by x -> x+1 and x -> 9x (the cyclic group Z17 and the multiplier subgroup of order 8 of GF(17)*) acts on them, and column 17 is fixed.
